defective_pattern: Lumping multiple research questions (e.g. Questions 2 and 3) into a single chapter section and using bullet-like bold strings instead of formal academic prose.
why_defective: Violates the fundamental One-Question-One-Section invariant, obscures independent findings, and compromises scholarly tone.
corrective_remedy: Enforce strictly separate, dedicated H2 sections for each research question and hypothesis, formatted in flowing, cohesive academic prose.
